claims: The ordered coach Freelance slot 3 is registered as a distinct candidate; this study does not prove automatic in-game activation.
External materials on Freelance settings and AI-vs-user activation do not identify physical PC22 Coach raw address or actual execution order.
conflicts: Third coach Freelance slot is not third offensive PlayType nor guaranteed next action; selection may be manual or influenced by ACE.
The 4 coach Freelance slots, 4 Player PlayTypes, Playbook and Series are distinct concepts.
metrics: exact coach identity and ordered source UI slot
